rationales.numerical_tolerance: The suite-wide exact-enumeration tolerance is retained for every semantic identity and clone audit.
rationales.candidate_prior: A uniform five-family prior makes recovery and false-selection rates interpretable against an exact 0.20 chance baseline without favoring context split.
rationales.predictive_grid: Five interior elemental Bernoulli probabilities plus finitely derived global blends keep every likelihood finite while spanning down-weighted, ambiguous, and strongly directional predictions.
rationales.free_cue_prediction_prior: A common uniform grid prior gives every free cue table the same elemental capacity; candidate-specific sharing and path structure receive their own explicit complexity charge.
rationales.cue_count: Three primary cues identify cue-local versus shared change; two and four cues test structural robustness without making exact inference needlessly large.
rationales.marker_cpt: Reliability 0.80 with 0.15 ambiguity makes context observable but never supplied as a label or deterministic fact.
rationales.root_observation_cpt: Reliability 0.85 retains the inherited nonsaturated root-evidence scale and supplies a finite common-emission bound.
rationales.baseline_and_corrective_predictions: Opposed nonsaturated cue rates create askable then/now prediction differences while retaining finite Bayes factors.
rationales.missingness: Fifteen-percent candidate-common missingness exercises exact neutral slices without dominating the informative sequence.
rationales.global_transition: A finite smooth mean-reverting global scale can express shared down-weighting while remaining distinct from reusable context tables.
rationales.cue_local_transition: Independent common-grid transitions permit genuine cue-specific reversal while using the same elemental smoothness scale as the other finite processes.
rationales.context_transition_prior: Dirichlet rows centered at 0.80 persistence permit learned returns and switches while explicitly charging transition uncertainty.
rationales.drift_templates: Slow, medium, and fast normalized nearest-neighbor kernels span continuous evolution without an abrupt context-indexed jump.
rationales.change_point_prior: Beta(1,9) assigns finite mass to no or late change while allowing a single learned abrupt onset and charging its timing uncertainty.
rationales.finite_information: The exact table supremum multiplies the largest supported cue, marker, and root likelihood ratios; all are finite interior probabilities.
rationales.complexity_matching: A 0.05-nat-per-token validation tolerance compares held-out predictions at similar posterior KL cost without equating raw parameter counts.
rationales.recovery_sesoi: The 0.60 rate is the rounded 75-percent movement from five-family chance toward the prior-predictive fifth-percentile attainable diagonal.
rationales.false_split_sesoi: The 0.10 ceiling is halfway from chance toward zero and is conservatively above the prior-predictive 95th-percentile wrong-family rate.
rationales.heldout_sesoi: The 0.01-nat margin is approximately half the 0.0201-nat KL between the nearest distinct public Bernoulli predictions.
rationales.probability_sesoi: A 0.05 probability contrast is one quarter of the smallest non-neutral spacing on the public predictive grid.
rationales.seed_blocks: Fresh V2.4.2 calibration and criterion blocks are disjoint and below 800000; prior diagnosis blocks 774000:774524, 776000:776144, and 780000:780129 plus calibration 781000:781499 are permanently barred from criterion evaluation.
rationales.formed_bank_bridge: The already qualified 40/40/40 bank supplies posterior initial conditions with audited provenance and prevents selecting states on redescription outcomes.
rationales.sequence_length: Ninety-six slices are used only for pilot-amended Gate-2 recovery after the adjudicated information-budget diagnosis; the original 32-slice primary protocol remains operative for held-out and composition assays, while 16, 32, and 64 remain robustness cells.
rationales.context_return: A 0.20 return rate makes retained historical predictions empirically queryable and distinguishes reusable context split from an absorbing change point.
rationales.root_evidence: Reliability 0.85 permits broad-field root revision without posterior saturation or an authored root target.
rationales.bootstrap: Ten thousand whole-world resamples preserve within-world temporal dependence and paired-arm identity.
